title: Exact module lower shriek for functors inducing equivalences on slices
statement: Fix the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be small sites [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and let $u:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be continuous and cocontinuous [def-weil-pbc-special-cocontinuous-functor](1). Let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal D$, and put $R'=R\circ u$ with its original restrictions. Assume that $\mathcal C$ has fibre products and equalizers and that $u$ preserves them (in particular, the corresponding limit cones exist in $\mathcal D$). For every $c\in\mathcal C$, assume that the induced functor $\mathcal C/c\to\mathcal D/u(c)$ is an equivalence of sites with their induced topologies: it is an equivalence of categories and a family covers if and only if its image covers. Equip these slices with the restrictions of $R'$ and $R$; the equivalence identifies those ring sheaves. Then precomposition $T:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal D,R)\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal C,R')$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] has an additive exact left adjoint $L:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal C,R')\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal D,R)$. Here $L\dashv T$ means natural bijections $\operatorname{Hom}_{R}(LM,N)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_{R'}(M,TN)$ for all module sheaves $M,N$, and exact means that $L$ carries every short exact sequence of module sheaves to a short exact sequence.

source.place: Tag 0797, lemma-lower-shriek-modules, gives the module left adjoint; Tag 0798, remark-when-shriek-equal, identifies its underlying abelian lower shriek when the induced slice functors are equivalences; Tag 04BH, lemma-exactness-lower-shriek, gives exactness of that abelian lower shriek.

proof.text: Use the same sites, functor and ring in [lem-sfb-local-slice-module-shriek-exact]. The small-site universes, continuity, cocontinuity, fibre products, equalizers and their preservation are exactly its hypotheses. Its localized ring sheaves have sections $R|_{u(c)}(d\to u(c))=R(d)$ and $R'|_c(c'\to c)=R'(c')$ by [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Pulling the first back along $u_c$ gives $R(u(c'))=R'(c')$, with the same restriction homomorphisms. The assumed equivalence of categories and equivalence of covering families is precisely its equivalence of induced slice sites. Thus the ring identification is the required one, with identity structural ring map; no terminal object is needed.

source.place: Tag 04IX (definition-localize-ringed-site); the slice and ring hypotheses of Tags 0797 and 0798.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-local-slice-module-shriek-exact] with these data. Its precomposition functor is exactly $T$, so its conclusion supplies an additive left adjoint $L:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal C,R')\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal D,R)$ which is exact. The adjunction means the natural bijections $\operatorname{Hom}_R(LM,N)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_{R'}(M,TN)$, and exactness means preservation of every short exact sequence, giving every assertion of the item. The additional underlying-abelian-sheaf comparison in the cited statement is not required here.
